Ben - attaching the artifacts you asked for. Notes below.

Attachments included: redwood-slo-summary.pdf, redwood-vs-hyperscaler-slo-comparison.pdf, po-template-acme.docx

Quick notes (high level):
- Failover model: Redwood deploys routing groups across multiple hosts and AZs. For hosted customers we run active-active in-region with automated health-based routing; on AZ failure we shift traffic to healthy hosts in the same region (no cold standbys). Typical failover RTO for session-less inference calls is < 10s for new requests; for in-flight KV-cached sessions we provide sticky routing and cache replication options - worst-case request replays can add 50-200ms per token while cache warms.
- Rate limits: default per-account per-route QPS limits are documented; we can provision higher burst allowances during POC. Limits are token-based so small requests are less likely to hit limits compared to large-batched calls.
- Error budgets: computed per-route over 30d windows with transparent dashboards. We expose incidents affecting the budget (and reasons) as part of the POC reporting.
- Comparison vs hyperscalers: hyperscalers often offer SLA at region-level but rely on multi-AZ warm/cold standbys which can cause higher tail latency during failover; they also have more opaque throttling behavior. Our doc highlights measured recovery times from prior incidents.

Suggested POC plan (2 weeks):
1) Kickoff + baseline run (2 days): push ACME sample traffic through Redwood, validate telemetry and dashboards.
2) Sustained load + spike tests (4 days): ramp to 2x expected peak, run short 10x bursts to evaluate throttling and burst policies.
3) Failover injection (2 days): simulate AZ failure and observe routing, cache behavior, and tail latency.
4) Error budget burn test (2 days): intentionally inject 503s on a small percentage of requests to validate how budgets are reported and escalations triggered.
5) Wrap + report (2 days): review findings, recommendations, and next steps for production rollout.

I'll also share a short runbook for the engineering sync. Send me the sample traffic URLs and a preferred date/time for the sync.
